name: Sweepick – Picking List for All Orders in One Pass for WooCommerce
author: ahmeda89

sections.description:
Sweepick turns the WooCommerce orders you select into one clean picking list: the same product from many orders is added up, sorted along your walking route and printed. Sweepick only reads your orders. It never changes statuses, stock or any order data.

Free

  • Picking report for the selected orders, filtered by status and date, with CSV export.
  • Sorting rules on product name.
  • Stock-shortage box, deleted-product and empty-order warnings.
  • Print invoice with your logo and company name.

Pro (monthly subscription, cancel any time)

  • Barcode picking and order review with a scanner.
  • Employees: one pick list per person.
  • Sorting rules by category, SKU and shelf location, two columns per page, and leaving out categories.
  • Carrier handover sheets and a shipping-company filter.
  • Fully customizable invoice: fields, columns, VAT, SSN, tracking, footer.

If a Pro license ends, the free features keep working.

Source code: every JavaScript and CSS file in this plugin (assets/) is plain, human-readable source. Nothing is minified or generated by a build tool.

External services

The Pro edition uses Freemius (https://freemius.com) for licensing, checkout and Pro updates, through the Freemius SDK bundled in vendor/freemius. The free edition also includes the SDK so the Upgrade and trial buttons work.

  • What it is used for: opt-in to the Freemius account, license activation and validation, trial, upgrade checkout and Pro update checks.
  • When data is sent: only after the site owner clicks “Allow & Continue” on the Freemius opt-in screen, or when a license key is activated. The owner can choose “Skip” and keep using the free features. Data is also sent when a trial is started, a license is checked, and when the plugin is activated, deactivated or uninstalled.
  • What is sent: homepage URL, plugin and SDK version, and license key (license essentials); WordPress and PHP versions, site language and title, and whether the plugin is active (basic site info); the WordPress user’s name and email (basic profile, on opt-in). A list of plugins and themes with versions is sent only if the owner allows it on the opt-in screen.
  • Terms and privacy: https://freemius.com/terms/ and https://freemius.com/privacy/

Sweepick itself sends no order or customer data anywhere.

Limitations

  • Barcode values must match the configured barcode field or the product SKU. Products with neither are confirmed manually.
  • Barcode progress is kept in the browser’s local storage and is not synchronized between devices or users.
  • The printable report opens as an HTML page; use the browser’s Print / Save as PDF command.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Sweepick (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Open Sweepick in the admin menu, choose the order statuses and dates, and press Generate.
  3. You can also select orders on the WooCommerce Orders page and use the Sweepick bulk actions.
  4. Settings has a tab for each area, and a Pro tab to buy or activate a license.
sections.faq:
Does Sweepick change my orders?

No. It only reads orders and prints.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. Sweepick declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage.

1.1.9

  • Fix: products with stock management turned off (“In stock” without a quantity) were wrongly listed in the stock-shortage box.

1.1.8

  • Print and Close buttons use an enqueued script instead of inline handlers. Pro-only styles and previews moved into the Pro edition.

1.1.7

  • The Pro tab now lists, for each section, what is free and what Pro adds.
